Johnny Varro was born in Brooklyn, New York and secured his jazz education at area jam sessions that often included Willie “The Lion” Smith and Joe Sullivan. He has played and recorded with a long list of jazz luminaries on both coasts and frequently performs at festivals in Europe. His arrangements are featured with his group Johnny Varro’s Swing 7.
Johnny was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 16, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
